title: Asset manifest row
description: One row of the asset manifest written by `build-manifest` and carried through `deduplicate` and `split`. The physical file is CSV, so every value is stored as text; the types below describe the logical value after parsing. Keeping this schema next to the code lets generated tables and downstream scripts be validated instead of guessed.
$comment: Property names must stay in sync with MANIFEST_FIELDS in src/mesh_filter/manifest.py; tests/test_manifest_schema.py fails if they drift.

asset_id.description: Stable, neutral project ID derived from source name and relative path. Never encodes the label.

source_dataset.description: Key under sources in the path configuration. Tracked for bias analysis, never used as a training feature.

source_uid.description: Identifier inside the source dataset; currently the relative path.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the original file. Empty when runtime.hash_files is false.

label.description: 1 for the proxy positive source, 0 for the proxy negative source.

label_origin.description: Where the label came from. dataset_proxy means source and label are perfectly confounded.

selection_rule.description: How the asset entered the dataset. Required to be meaningful for negatives, since their selection is the weakest link in a proxy label.

validity_status.description: invalid means the current pipeline cannot use the file; it does not imply label = 0.

error_code.description: Machine-countable error type, for example the exception class name. Empty when parse_status is parsed.

duplicate_group_id.description: Group ID shared by all rows that must stay in the same split. Falls back to asset_id when the asset is unique.

canonical_version.description: Version of the canonicalization output. Empty while canonicalization is not enabled.
